Future<void> run(items, int width) async {
 for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i = i + width) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  if (items.isNotEmpty) { await Future.wait(items.skip(i).take(width).map(read)); }
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await other(i);
 }
 for (var i = 0; i < items.length; ++i) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  await Future.wait([read(items[i])]);
 }
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
 for (final batch in items.slices(width)) { await Future.wait(batch.map(read)); }
}
